en.title: Floating touch stick
en.body: Play games can start the stick at a player's touch within a battlefield area, define a CSS-pixel dead zone, and reserve pause or HUD regions for ordinary input. The first touch keeps control outside the canvas, and lifting, cancellation, pause, or opening a modal or menu clears movement.

zh.title: 浮动触屏摇杆
zh.body: Play 游戏可在战场区域内以触点为摇杆中心，设置 CSS 像素死区，并为暂停按钮或 HUD 保留正常输入。第一个触点拖出画布后仍可操控，抬起、取消、暂停或打开模态界面或菜单时摇杆归零。
